summary: Implemented the terminal window title setting. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and admits Tuple[ControlType, str] in ControlCode; rich/control.py adds the format entry "\x1b]0;{title}\x07" and Control.title(title); rich/console.py adds Console.set_window_title(title) beside show_cursor, returning True when written to a terminal and False otherwise; rich/_windows_renderer.py dispatches SET_WINDOW_TITLE to term.set_title(title) once per control; CHANGELOG.md gets an Unreleased "Added" bullet linking pull request 2200; tests added to tests/test_console.py, tests/test_control.py, and tests/test_windows_renderer.py. Not run: tests and Black (Black is not installed; no added line exceeds 88 characters, checked by hand). Nothing committed.
